da.name: LL Dance Studio
da.short: Backstage – danseskolens app: træninger, beskeder, billeder og hold.
da.desc:
Kun for godkendte medlemmer af LL Dance Studio (dansere, forældre og trænere). Ny? Tilmeld dig på ilumie.com/llds – så kan du logge ind her.

LL Dance Studio – Backstage er appen for danseskolens medlemmer: dansere, forældre og trænere.

DIT HOLD
Næste træninger, afbud med ét tryk, beskeder fra træneren, koreografi-videoer, formationer og holdets mapper med billeder og dokumenter.

DIN UGE
Alle dine og dine børns træninger, events og salbookinger samlet i én tidslinje – med besked, når noget flyttes eller aflyses.

EVENTS OG STÆVNER
Program, mødetid, pakkeliste og tilmelding til shows, konkurrencer og julebal.

HOLDETS EGET RUM
Opslag, billeder og kommentarer – kun for holdet. Officielle beskeder fra skolen ligger på forsiden, så intet vigtigt drukner.

TILMELDING OG BETALING
Tilmeld nye hold og auditions direkte i appen, se prisen før du bekræfter, og betal med MobilePay. Kvitteringen kommer på mail.

STJERNESHOPPEN
Merchandise og klippekort – bestil i appen, hent i studiet.

FOR FORÆLDRE
Følg dine børns hold uden eget login til barnet. Børn får deres eget login, når de er gamle nok.

FOR TRÆNERE OG ADMIN
Fremmøde, vikarbytte, sæsonplan, salbookinger, beskeder med læsekvittering, auditions og medlemsoverblik.

Appen er kun for medlemmer af LL Dance Studio. Du logger ind med den e-mail, du er oprettet med – ingen adgangskode, bare en engangskode på mail.

Privatlivspolitik: https://ilumie.com/llds/privacy/
Vilkår: https://ilumie.com/llds/terms/

en.name: LL Dance Studio
en.short: Backstage – the dance school's app: trainings, messages, photos and teams.
en.desc:
For approved members of LL Dance Studio only (dancers, parents, trainers). New? Sign up at ilumie.com/llds first – then log in here.

LL Dance Studio – Backstage is the app for the dance school's members: dancers, parents and trainers.

YOUR TEAM
Next trainings, absence with one tap, messages from the trainer, choreography videos, formations and the team's folders with photos and documents.

YOUR WEEK
All your and your children's trainings, events and studio bookings in one timeline – with a message when something is moved or cancelled.

EVENTS AND COMPETITIONS
Programme, meeting time, packing list and sign-up for shows, competitions and the Christmas ball.

THE TEAM'S OWN ROOM
Posts, photos and comments – for the team only. Official messages from the school live on the home screen, so nothing important gets lost.

SIGN-UP AND PAYMENT
Join new teams and auditions directly in the app, see the price before you confirm, and pay with MobilePay. The receipt arrives by e-mail.

THE SHOP
Merchandise and punch cards – order in the app, collect in the studio.

FOR PARENTS
Follow your children's teams without a login for the child. Children get their own login when they are old enough.

FOR TRAINERS AND ADMIN
Attendance, substitutes, season plan, studio bookings, messages with read receipts, auditions and member overview.

The app is for members of LL Dance Studio only. You log in with the e-mail you are registered with – no password, just a one-time code by e-mail.

Privacy policy: https://ilumie.com/llds/privacy/
Terms: https://ilumie.com/llds/terms/
